name: How do I choose the right paint sheen for different remodeled rooms?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right paint sheen for different remodeled rooms?

acceptedAnswer.text: The right paint finish depends on moisture exposure, surface use, and traffic levels in the renovated room. Bathrooms and kitchens require moisture-resistant formulas in satin or semi-gloss finishes to prevent mildew and allow easy cleaning around water splashes. High-traffic living areas and hallways benefit from eggshell or satin finishes, which balance durability with subtle sheen. Ceilings perform best with flat paints that minimize glare and conceal drywall seams. For architectural elements like trim, doors, and custom moldings, durable semi-gloss or gloss paints provide clean contrast and resist scuff marks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Use moisture-resistant satin or semi-gloss in kitchens and baths, eggshell in hallways and living rooms, flat paint on ceilings, and semi-gloss on trim.
